subject: Flip pfail flag while marking node as failed (#2012)
reason: The change adds one line that clears the stray CLUSTER_NODE_PFAIL flag when a node is marked NOADDR+FAIL after a node-ID mismatch (a peer that did CLUSTER RESET), restoring the PFAIL/FAIL mutual-exclusion invariant. It has no functional effect: the NOADDR flag already excludes this node from the gossip sections (cluster_legacy.c:4265,4298), the stats_pfail_nodes counter returns early for NOADDR nodes before counting (line 5291 precedes line 5293), and reachability/quorum counting (line 5801) excludes any FAIL node regardless of PFAIL.
